entities.name: Archduke Charles Joseph of Austria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Joseph was an Archduke of Austria and Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights (1662–1664). He was also the Bishop of Olmütz, and Breslau, Passau.
